diagnosis: The Next.js App Router DELETE handler ensures user authentication via Clerk's currentUser(), but executes prisma.webhookEndpoint.delete using only context.params.endpointId. It fails to constrain deletion to webhooks owned by user.id, permitting any authenticated user to delete webhook dispatch endpoints of other developers.
